scope: Ordinary functional QA of owned Free/private PostgreSQL18 parameter declarations and observations
provenance: Normalized native browser requests/responses and direct authenticated read probes captured during this pass; complete request bodies and responses included. No network interception or injected latency. API probes supplement native UI journeys.

contract.summary: Parameter names are case-insensitive; memory unit names are case-sensitive.

request.query:
mutation CreateDatabase($name: String!, $databaseName: String, $databaseUser: String, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $plan: String, $version: String, $diskSizeGB: Int, $public: Boolean) {
  createDatabase(
    name: $name
    databaseName: $databaseName
    databaseUser: $databaseUser
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    plan: $plan
    version: $version
    diskSizeGB: $diskSizeGB
    public: $public
  ) {
    id
    name
    databaseName
    databaseUser
    plan
    status
    projectId
    environmentId
    __typename
  }
}

limits: Only TimeZone/timezone were live case variants; no general claim about every setting.
Observed means a name exists in non-default settings, not equality with the declaration.
Unavailable-runtime and unknown-name controls were read in existing tests, not induced live.
No authenticated Render timing or UI measurement.
A separate mobile document-width observation was not investigated or filed.
